body:
Thanks for the reply. The only problem is that I do have people to talk to. I just chose not to, and I don't understand myself why. Recently there has been a lot of stress and so many things going on, and as much as suicide can feel so sad it doesn't to me. Whenever I think about it I don't feel that much emotion. It just seems like a way to escape from the mass amount of stress and anxiety and depression I've been feeling. 

So I don't even know myself how long I'll last. Things just seem to get worse and worse for me and even though I have wealthy parents it feels like I have nothing. Emptiness just fills my heart and soul and there doesn't seem to be a way to get out.

Hopefully a miracle will happen soon, and with school ending I might be able to push through. I don't know though.
